subject: otel-semconv-proposal

metrics.proposal: Add gen_ai.eval.* provenance attributes with signed measurement card as reference artifact
attributes_proposed: gen_ai.eval.merkle_root (root the card is included in)
metrics.rationale: No current OTel convention covers signed/attested eval events. Observability vendors (Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana) watch this repo.
metrics.action: Comment on semantic-conventions-genai #171, or open issue if closed

honest_sentence: OTel semconv proposal: add gen_ai.eval.* attributes for signed measurement card provenance (card_id, issuer_did, merkle_root, timestamp_authority, signature, corrections_count). First convention for signed/attested eval events.
